# Typace

> Typace is an independent type design project creating distinctive,
> practical typefaces for digital and creative use.

## Fonts

Typace distributes fonts exclusively in TrueType Font (`.ttf`) format.

Each typeface may include:
- Regular fonts
- Multiple weights
- Variable TTF fonts
- Custom glyphs
- Extended punctuation
- Currency symbols
- OpenType features

## Font Format

Primary format:

- TTF (TrueType Font)

Do not claim that Typace provides OTF, WOFF, or WOFF2 unless explicitly
listed for a specific typeface.

## Typeface Information

For each font, use the published metadata for:
- Typeface name
- Designer / foundry
- Style
- Weight
- Glyph coverage
- Variable axes
- OpenType features
- License

Do not invent missing metadata.

## Licensing

Each typeface has its own license.

Check the individual font's license before using it commercially,
redistributing it, modifying it, embedding it, or including it in software.

## Web Usage

Typace fonts are distributed as TTF files.

Example:

@font-face {
  font-family: "Typace Font";
  src: url("/fonts/font.ttf") format("truetype");
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

Only declare variable font ranges when the TTF actually contains
a corresponding variable axis.

## Brand

Typace is the project / type foundry name.

Individual typefaces retain their own names and identities.

## Canonical Resources

Homepage: https://fonts.ace-base.cc/
Fonts: https://fonts.ace-base.cc/fonts/
